title: Optimal Nonergodic Primal-Dual Complexity of Efficient Inexact Parameter-Free Augmented Lagrangian Methods
summary: Augmented Lagrangian (AL) methods are a classical framework for constrained optimization, but for directly verifiable approximate KKT points, known first-order complexity bounds for standard inexact AL methods are suboptimal, while the best known proximal augmented Lagrangian (PAL) bounds retain an additional logarithmic factor. We consider linearly constrained convex composite problems with a smooth convex term and a possibly nonsmooth closed proper convex term with compact domain.
